name: 32132 · Edgewater, FL
findings: ZIP 32132 (Edgewater) has 25 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32132 (Edgewater) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 32132 (Edgewater) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 24% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 32132 (Edgewater) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 67% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 24% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
